meta.title: Soulwick – Grab your friends. Light the dark.
meta.description: Soulwick is the pixel roguelite you rush into with your friends. Every run is different, every boss is a clip – and you can wish for your own. Co-op for up to four, an endless dungeon, a cozy village and Wick, your companion.

hero.lead: The pixel roguelite you rush into with your friends. Every run is different, every boss is a clip.
hero.install: On your phone? <link>Install it as an app</link>.
hero.releaseText: In your browser, on Steam, Android, iPhone and iPad, all from day one.
hero.platformNote: Free in the browser and on phones, a small price on Steam. Crossplay puts you all in one room, whatever you play on.

coop.title: Rush in with your friends
coop.lead: Open a room, send your friends the link, and they're in. Up to four of you, each with your own figure and colour, and the chaos starts in the very first room.
beats: One link or six letters, and your friends are in. No sign-up, no waiting.
Everyone picks a figure and a colour, everyone gets their own upgrades. The gold goes into one pot.
If someone falls, stand next to them for a moment and off you go again.
coop.guilds: Want to stick together? Found a guild with a shared treasury and climb the leaderboards as a team.
coop.vitrineAlt: A co-op room: four friends as four different figures, Wick, the room code and the invite link

bosses.title: Wish for a boss
bosses.lead: Beat a boss and you get a wish at the campfire: describe your nightmare boss. A few rooms later it's standing in front of you and your friends, built by an AI in Soulwick's style. Made for clips.
steps: After a boss fight, describe your nightmare at the campfire. The wilder, the better.
While you keep playing, an AI builds your boss: look, name and attacks, all in the game's style.
A few rooms later it's there. Beat it together, record it, send it around.
bosses.examplesNote: Examples we made up. Yours will be weirder.
examples: A giant toaster that shoots burning toast
Pops out of the floor when it's hot.
Laughs at you. Then it bites.
A knight who is really just a very angry pumpkin
Rolls at you when he runs out of patience.
A chicken. But huge. And furious.
Wick knows this one. Wick is scared.

wick.title: Meet Wick
wick.lead: This is Wick, your companion. A tiny wick creature with a flame on its head that lights your way from your very first step into the dark.
wick.text: Where Wick goes, the chicken is never far behind. Nobody knows why. The chicken isn't telling.
wick.outfitsTitle: Outfits for you, Wick and your village
wick.outfitsText: Pick colours and looks that suit your crew. Only looks, never power.

descent.title: No two descents are alike
descent.lead: Every room wants something different from you: fight, hold out or win a mini-game. Every 15 rooms a boss is waiting, then a campfire, then a new world. And it never ends.
biomes: Torches, bones and a king who charges with his shield.
Green light, toxic puddles and slimes that split.
Fog, violet cracks and shadows that blind you.
Lava cracks and a golem who breaks the floor.
descent.minigamesTitle: Not every room is a fight
minigames: Keep a flame alive against the night.
Lead a lost villager home. Sometimes it's a chicken.
Catch the souls before they fade.
Something crawls out of the walls. Seal the cracks.
The crowned one runs off with the gold.
Stone guardians fear only the light.
The floor gives way. Hold on where there's still ground.
descent.skill: Five weapons, piles of upgrades, a choice at every fork. The first rooms are for everyone, the deep ones for the brave.

village.title: Your village
village.lead: After the dungeon comes the cozy part. The forge makes you stronger, the merchant packs supplies, the chronicle remembers your best runs. And the chicken pecks around as if nothing happened.
items: Gold from the dungeon goes into the forge, the trading post and your home. Your village grows, and you head into the next run stronger.
Decorations, paths, flowers and outfits: your village, your style. Only looks, never power.
Bring your friends over, show them what you've built and hang out between runs. Or drop by their village.
village.sceneAlt: The village in the game by day: forge with glowing fire, chronicle, fountain square, market stall, villagers and chickens

roadmap.title: What's next
roadmap.lead: Everything above is in the game at release. This is what comes after.
roadmap.legend: The lit torch is up next.
steps: Only mini-games, and this time you play against each other. Same rooms, same look, more shouting.
New mini-games, new bosses, new worlds. Soulwick keeps growing after release.

faq.title: Questions and answers
items: In the browser Soulwick is free, and on phones too. On Steam it costs a small amount. You can only ever buy looks, never strength: no pay-to-win, no loot boxes.
With up to three friends in one room: send them the link or the room code and they're in. Playing on your own works too, of course.
Which devices does it run on?
In the browser on computer and phone, with nothing to install, on Steam, on Android and on iPhone and iPad. Crossplay puts you all in one room.
How does the wish boss work?
After a boss fight you describe a boss at the campfire. An AI builds it in the game's style, and a few rooms later you fight it. The examples on this page are made up by us.
Soulwick is made for teens and young adults. The fights are pixel art without blood, and there are no loot boxes. The official age rating comes from the stores once Soulwick is out there.
No. No sign-up, no email: you pick a player name and off you go.
release: There's no date yet; we only name dates once they're certain. From day one you can play in the browser, on Steam, Android, iPhone and iPad. The news always has the latest.
released: Right in your browser, with nothing to install, and on Steam, Android, iPhone and iPad. The news always has what's new.

openSource.title: Open source
openSource.text: Soulwick's code is public on GitHub (GPL-3.0). Graphics, music, the name and the characters stay ours.

lbText: Three boards: solo, group and guilds, per season and all-time. The deepest room counts; ties go to the faster run.
lbGuilds: Guilds get a shared treasury, their own page and their own board to climb together.
lbAtRelease: The boards go live at release.

footerText: Soulwick is the pixel roguelite you rush into with your friends. A tiny light, a cozy village and a dungeon that never ends.
